set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.0; milestone-video.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: AC4-S1 is closed; this child retains its original loader/coverage acceptance and now depends explicitly on the request/extent follow-up.

Remaining / next action: Implement the multipart caption package/disk loader with ordered edition parts, global-to-local ordinal joins, verified byte/receipt checks and per-part observed coverage; unsampled spans remain gaps. Complete selection-bound request/extent first.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Child of bd-01M35JG7DXD7NSEE4WVEKT3CSF per T1. Acceptance: an edition is an ordered part table; global request ordinals map to (part, local ordinal) through the v2 manifest; output gives per-part loci plus observed coverage (sampled ordinals, PTS, density), with unsampled spans as unavailable gaps; the disk loader reads the frames, request and caption envelopes, verifyOutcome runs over the bytes, and a missing receipt refuses. Depends on AC4-S1.
